changeLog.comment: WRITABLE VERSION 1 (registration-only contract retired). The consulate's public phone and public email are now single governed facts in src/data/site.yaml, rendered from that one record by the contact section, the footer and the JSON-LD (src/lib/content.ts). This contract declares exactly TWO operations: the closed public_phone_patch coupled set (two pointers, one file) and the schema-v6 public_email_patch (two pointers, one file). It declares NO text-surface, link, typed-page, opening-hours or article operation: section copy lives in markdown frontmatter the text-patch grammar cannot address, navigation is same-page anchors rather than published routes, the site has no typed-page renderer, publishes no opening-hours fact, and its insights are media-bearing PDFs. Each is documented below as denied with its reason, so a proposal for any of them is refused before anything durable exists.

fields.comment: The consulate mobile number: one visible display value and one dialable href, both in the Mobile contact row. The contact section, the footer and the JSON-LD `telephone` all render from these two pointers, so this pair IS the complete render-reachable occurrence set. `render: tel` writes the literal `tel:` plus the bare E.164 input; `render: raw` writes the display input verbatim. The Wellington embassy number is a different fact and is not part of this operation.

preconditions.comment: The two governed pointers address contact rows by index, so a reorder of `contact.rows` would silently retarget the phone policy at the email or location row. Before applying any patch, the publisher MUST assert every pointer/value pair below against the BASE revision and refuse the candidate on any mismatch.

CLOSED-SET PRECONDITION. Before applying any public_phone_patch the publisher MUST scan EVERY file under the repository root, excluding only the exact paths in `scanExclusions`, for both literals in RAW TEXT, and every occurrence found MUST be accounted for as a declared target (counted in `expectedOccurrences`) or an explicitly declared `nonRenderingOccurrences` entry. An occurrence that is neither refuses the whole candidate: fewer occurrences means a declared target no longer exists (stale policy, must not write blind); more means an undeclared occurrence appeared in the rendered surface. This site keeps the number in exactly one data record, so there are no non-rendering occurrences to declare.

scanExclusions.reason: Third-party dependencies, never a renderer-owned public fact source.
Historical version-control objects legitimately retain prior values.
Derived build output; governed source bytes are scanned instead.
Legacy hosting cache; never a source.
Authority documents may quote governed values but do not render.
Project briefs and notes do not render.

public_phone.comment: CLOSED, TWO-INPUT CONTRACT. A public_phone_patch proposal supplies exactly `display` and `e164` and nothing else; neither has a default and neither may be derived from the other. The `coupledSet` binds both pointers into one atomic write.

display.comment: The visible grouping the consulate publishes, written verbatim.

e164.comment: Bare E.164 digits; the materialiser prefixes `tel:` itself.

documentedOperations.comment: The withdrawn legacy hours operation. The site publishes no opening-hours statement; nothing here was ever a target for it.

Section copy lives in src/content/sections/**/*.md frontmatter and markdown bodies; the text-patch grammar addresses YAML data pointers and a pages-record layout this site does not have. A text-surface catalogue over src/data/site.yaml prose is a reviewed version 2.
Primary navigation is same-page anchors (#opportunity, #consular-services, …), not published routes; the link materialiser resolves internal destinations against published routes only.
The site has no typed-page renderer and no typed-page registry file.
The site publishes no structured opening-hours record (visits are by appointment). Manufacturing one is a content decision for the Consulate, not a policy entry.
src/content/insights/*.md requires a PDF, page count and hero image per record — media-bearing by construction. Authored insights need a media-admission contract first.

coupledSet.comment: Both phone pointers live in one file and move together or not at all; the candidate-manifest changed_paths for this operation is exactly [src/data/site.yaml].

publicEmailPatch.comment: The consulate's public email: one visible display value and one mailto href in the Email contact row. The contact section, the footer and the JSON-LD `email` render from these two pointers. The Wellington embassy address is a different fact and is never touched.
